LanguageData.CC_WhatsNew_Text: Rimfolk has been updated to version {0} since you last played. The newest round:
LanguageData.CC_WhatsNew_More: Every update, newest first, is on the "What's new" page at the top of the Almanac. This letter comes once per update; the mod settings can turn it off.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_WhatsNewLetter_Tip: On (default): when you load a save after Rimfolk has been updated, a letter lists the newest round's highlights, with a button to the Almanac's "What's new" page. A new colony gets the welcome letter instead.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_WhatsNewLetter: On: "Rimfolk has been updated" once per update. Off: see the Almanac's "What's new" page.
